title: Endpoint lower bound for the logarithmic derivative
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be monotone and nonconstant. For each $S\subseteq[n]$, let $\widehat f(S)$ be its Fourier coefficient under the uniform measure, and define $q_f(t)=\bigl(1-\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}(1-2t)^{|S|}\widehat f(S)\bigr)/2$. If $p_c,p\in(0,1)$, $p_c\le p$, and $q_f(p_c)=1/2$, then $\left.\frac{d}{dt}\bigl[-\log(1-q_f(t))\bigr]\right|_{t=p}\ge \frac{1}{2(1-p)}$.
